We evaluate our approach on the One-Billion-Word and Yelp datasets, following the preprocessing steps outlined in prior work on infilling and lexically constrained generation . These datasets consist of examples with 1 to 6 keywords that must be infilled while maintaining their relative order to generate coherent sentences.
